mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgtransit_route_operation ( route_type, bus_name, terminal_info, dispatch_interval, inquiry_phone, route_url, route_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{routeType}, #{busName}, #{terminalInfo}, #{dispatchInterval}, #{inquiryPhone}, #{routeUrl}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sgtransit_route_operation SET route_type=#{routeType}, bus_name=#{busName}, terminal_info=#{terminalInfo}, dispatch_interval=#{dispatchInterval}, inquiry_phone=#{inquiryPhone}, route_url=#{routeUrl}, route_status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE route_no=#{routeNo}
